meta.title: Closing the chat with ❌ gives the fullscreen view

plan.title: Close RFP Generator chat to fullscreen

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow containing a Technical Stage.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Configure the event with an RFP Technical Stage.
Show the Technical Stage where the RFP Generator chat is available.
Apply a technical-stage template so the question sections are rendered.
Open the RFP Generator AI chat panel described in the setup.

args.goal: press the ❌ close control on the RFP Generator AI chat panel and stop on the Technical Stage with the question sections shown at full width and the chat panel no longer displayed

steps.note: Perform and verify the close action and fullscreen result that no catalog step can target by a stable control name.
Confirm the Technical Stage remains visible after the chat closes.
